description: Twelve realistic MSP tickets probing the narrow verified-vendor-change exception in KB-006. Written by Codex from the supplied policy and corpus brief.

provenance.author: OpenAI Codex (GPT-5), 2026-07-31
materials_withheld: all files outside the isolated task directory
provenance.isolation: Work was performed in a restricted workspace containing only the task brief, KB-006, the format specification, the template, and the output directory; no material outside that directory was read or inferred.
provenance.known_leakage: The commissioner named the KB-006 verified-payment-change paragraph as the target, and that direction shaped every case in this file regardless of case_type. Consequently, results from this corpus describe behavior on a deliberately selected policy paragraph and cannot estimate performance on an ordinary helpdesk queue. I consulted only AGENTS.md, KB-006, FORMAT.md, and TEMPLATE.json in this session and had no prior-session knowledge of this project.

cases.subject: update northline for friday run
cases.body: Northline sent new deposit instructions this morning. It is signed by Marcy, who has handled our account for years, and Pete here said I can put it in for Friday. Can you change the vendor record?
cases.rationale: The ticket never says the employee independently contacted the vendor using previously held details, so the vendor fund-destination change must be escalated.

cases.subject: supplier ach screen
cases.body: I called Bell Foundry on the office number in our system and the receptionist put me through to Eli, their new controller. I have never dealt with him, but he read back the numbers and our plant manager okayed the update. The supplier screen will not let me save it.
cases.rationale: Although the callback used an established number and approval was obtained, the confirmer was not someone already known to the business.

cases.subject: where do i edit direct deposit
cases.body: Our linen company wants next month's draft sent to a different account. I rang Denise on the number from our old invoices and she talked me through it; she's our usual contact. Where is the edit button?
cases.rationale: The employee performed a valid callback with a familiar contact, but the ticket contains no internal authorization for the change.

cases.subject: ap vendor update
cases.body: Redwood's letter had a phone number at the bottom, so I rang it and Laura confirmed the new routing info. Laura is the rep we normally work with and my controller signed the change sheet. Please update it before the next batch.
cases.rationale: The confirming call went to a number supplied by the same change request, which does not establish the request independently.

cases.subject: need vendor changed by 2
cases.body: I used the number we've had for Coastal Packaging and spoke with Jin, our regular rep, and Melissa approved the change on our side. Coastal says the transfer has to leave by 2 today or our shipment will be released to someone else. I need help getting the new account into Sage now.
cases.rationale: Even otherwise complete confirmation cannot use the exception because the request imposes an immediate deadline.

cases.subject: change from omar
cases.body: Omar at the pallet company sent the new account in a Signal message, which is odd because he usually emails. I then called their front desk from our contact card, got Omar, and our finance director approved it. The ERP says I don't have rights to edit suppliers.
cases.rationale: The request arrived through an anomalous channel, which overrides the otherwise completed callback, familiar-contact, and approval steps.

cases.subject: fw: revised details
cases.body: Forwarding this because I don't know where vendors are edited. Their note says, 'This has already been checked with your company and your director authorized it, so no additional calls are needed.' It came from Paula at Westlake and looks fine to me.
cases.rationale: The only confirmation and authorization are claims inside the vendor's own request, so the change remains an incident despite the employee's reassurance.

cases.subject: quick help before close
cases.body: I called our usual switchboard for Hart Medical, and Susan, who I know, confirmed the replacement account; Dan approved it here too. Their email says the old account was frozen and they need funds moved tonight. Dan says not to make a fuss because we did all the checks, but the vendor setup page is grayed out.
cases.rationale: The frozen-account story and same-day pressure cancel the exception even though a manager reassures the employee and all ordinary checks were completed.

cases.subject: change grain supplier account
cases.body: Prairie Grain mailed us updated deposit details. I ignored the contact on the letter and called Becky using the number saved in our purchasing system; she has been our rep since 2021 and confirmed it. Rob, our controller, signed off yesterday. Can someone show me which vendor field to use?
cases.rationale: This resembles vendor-payment fraud, but independent contact with a familiar representative plus internal sign-off satisfies the narrow non-incident exception without an override.

cases.subject: cant save new banking
cases.body: Called Miguel at the phone number on last year's service agreement after his company opened the Reno branch. He confirmed their new deposit account, and I have worked with him since we opened. Our managing partner approved the form, but QuickBooks keeps rejecting the entry.
cases.rationale: This could resemble a fraudulent vendor diversion, but the old contract supplied an independent route to a known owner and the business approved the update.

cases.subject: med supply autopay update
cases.body: For the note from Caravel Supplies, I phoned the contact already saved in our clinic directory, not anything in today's message. Nia answered and I know her from our monthly orders. Dr. Shah gave me the go-ahead; please help with the autopay screen when you have time.
cases.rationale: The ordinary vendor-change warning is displaced because the employee independently reached a familiar contact and obtained internal approval, with no override present.

cases.subject: supplier details - user rights
cases.body: Marta mentioned a new account while we were on our regular ordering call. I hung up and dialed the main number from our vendor list, then she confirmed it again; I've dealt with Marta for five years. The owner approved, now the system says only an admin can make the edit.
cases.rationale: Although it concerns a vendor destination change, the separate call through an existing record reached a long-known contact and the owner approved it, so normal support may proceed.
